description: Línea de Costa del Reino de España (INSPIRE) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Hidrográfico de la Marina. Coast line extracted from the electronic nautical charts (ENC) of purpose 4 and 5 of navigation published by the Hydrographic Institute of the Navy (IHM) of Spain. The resolution base is considered a scale of 1:50000 although there are areas where the resolution can reach 1:22000. Coverage: Instituto Hidrográfico de la Marina. The portal shows the English title as "Coastline of the Kingdom of Spain (INSPIRE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Hidrográfico de la Marina. Its keywords include Shoreline, IHM, Línea de Costa, Coastline, Bajamar, High Tide. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2022-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
